main_text.l: deuter[?] id totum habet ab Ethica. 4. Theologiam reuelatam, quæ nitItur

PROOEMIVM LOGICÆ.
HOC procemio nomen, definitio, obiectum, ge-
nus, causæ, necessitas, & diuisio Logicæ expli-
cantur. Logica derivatur à Græco λόγος[?] idest
sermo, quia agit de sermone obiectiuo in com-
muni, & diuiig[?] t sermonem internum, vt proba-
bitur infrà. Aliter vocatur Dialectica quæ deri-
vatur à Græco διαλέγεσθαι[?] idest differere, quia
tradit præcepta bene differendi, idest bene definiendi, dividendi, & ar-
gumentandi, licet interdum sumatur strictè pro illa parte. Logicæ
quæ tradit tantùm præcepta probabiliter differendi.
2. Logica distinguitur in naturalem, quæ est facultas differendi hominis
congenita, & secundum alios est solertia mentis in disserendo[?]; &
artificialem quæ est habitus differendi arte acquisitus aut infusus, & di-
stingui solet in docentem, vtentem, & disputandi, & discursiuam; & hæ omnes in
habitualem, actualem & obiectiuam, quæ identificantur cum obiecto,
actu & habitu earum.
3. Logica docens tradit præcepta bene differendi, qualia sunt ista, de-
finitio debet esse adæquata definito, Syllogismus debet constare tribus
terminis &c. Logica vtens differit secundum præcepta. Logica verò
discursiua probat præcepta per rationes evidentes, de qua in posterum
agemus.
DE DEFINITIONE LOGICÆ.
LOgica definitur scientia de modis differendi obiectiuis in co-
mmuni. Modus differendi distinguitur, in formalem & obiecti-
uum, & vterque in simplicem & compositum. Modus differendi compo-
situs sunt duæ res quarum vna manifestat altera, vt vestigium leporis &
tiai[?] situs.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "deuter" at the start of the fragment, and "conferenda" (printed sense unclear, the scan shows "confe renda"); "diuiig t" in paragraph 1, probably "diuisi" or "distinguit" but not clearly legible; "dilse endo" in paragraph 2, read as "disserendo"; "tiai situs" at the end, probably "trai situs" or similar; the Greek words "λόγος" and "διαλέγεσθαι" are read from a small scan and may be inexact. The large initial of paragraph 1 is read as H ("HOC"), but the scan shows an ornamental letter. The lower-right "Digitized by Google" stamp is left out.
